name: Conductor
oneLiner: 在 Mac 上并行运行一组编程 Agent（Claude Code、Codex 等）的应用，每个任务有独立工作区、分支和审阅；2026-11 团队并入 Meta 超级智能实验室，Conductor Cloud 11 月下旬关停
oneLinerEn: Mac app for running teams of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex and more) in parallel, each task with its own workspace, branch and review; the team joined Meta Superintelligence Labs in Nov 2026 and Conductor Cloud shuts down in late November.
